about.title: About Brevard Public Schools
about.content: Brevard Public Schools is the countywide public school district for Brevard County, Florida. The district serves Space Coast communities including Palm Bay, Melbourne, Titusville, Cocoa, Cocoa Beach, Merritt Island, Rockledge, Viera, Satellite Beach, Melbourne Beach, Indian Harbour Beach, West Melbourne, and Cape Canaveral. Its printable district calendars list teacher preplanning, first student day, separate first days for kindergarten and pre-kindergarten, holidays, student holidays, teacher workdays, FTE survey weeks, early release Fridays, exam early release windows, report card publication dates, Winter Break, Spring Break, and the last student and teacher days.

about.title: Why the Brevard Calendar Needs Space Coast Context
about.content: Brevard's school calendar is shaped by more than normal holiday timing. Families in the county often coordinate school days with aerospace, defense, healthcare, port, tourism, and military schedules. Launch operations around Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Patrick Space Force Base assignments, cruise traffic at Port Canaveral, and beachside bridge commutes may influence family planning around student holidays and early release Fridays. Hurricane season also overlaps with the opening quarter of school, and Brevard's official calendar points families to a separate Hurricane Make-up Days document for storm-related schedule changes.

planningTips.title: Planning Tips for Brevard County Families
content: Add Friday early release days separately. Brevard's printable calendars list many Friday early release days, plus exam early release windows in December and May.
Kindergarten and pre-kindergarten start after the first student day. The official calendars list separate first days for those grade levels.
Check the separate Hurricane Make-up Days document before booking late-May or early-June travel, especially after any tropical storm closure.
Beachside families should plan extra time on early release Fridays because bridge traffic can affect pickup from schools on or near the barrier islands.
Military and aerospace households should compare school holidays with Patrick Space Force Base, Kennedy Space Center, Cape Canaveral, and contractor work schedules rather than assuming breaks align.

Palm Bay, Melbourne, Titusville, Cocoa, Viera, Rockledge, Merritt Island, Cocoa Beach, Satellite Beach, Cape Canaveral, West Melbourne, and beachside communities all use the Brevard Public Schools district calendar unless a specific school or program publishes a separate schedule.

Port Canaveral and Cape Canaveral work schedules can make short student holidays more important for childcare planning.

customSections.label: Space Coast Planning Notes
customSections.content: Brevard's calendar has several local planning details that generic Florida calendar summaries miss. Early release is usually a Friday pattern, kindergarten and pre-kindergarten start later than the first student day, and the official district calendar points to a separate hurricane make-up day document. Those details matter for families managing base schedules, aerospace contractor shifts, Port Canaveral work, and beachside transportation.

groups.label: School-year mechanics
items: The official calendars total 180 pupil days and 190 teacher paid days.
Kindergarten and pre-kindergarten have separate first-day entries after the main first student day.
Exam days in December and May are also early release days.

groups.label: Local schedule pressure
items: Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral launch activity can affect work schedules and local traffic even when school remains open.
Patrick Space Force Base families should compare BPS holidays with military duty schedules and PCS timing.
Beachside and mainland families should account for causeway and bridge traffic on early release Fridays.

customSections.label: Understanding Brevard Calendar Terms
customSections.content: Brevard's printable district calendar uses several school-calendar terms that can affect family planning. These definitions help families read the date list without confusing student attendance days, staff workdays, and early release windows.

groups.label: Attendance terms
items: Student Holiday: a no-school day for students, even when staff may have work scheduled.
Teacher Workday: a staff workday when students usually do not attend classes.
Pupil Days: the student instructional days counted in the official school-year total.

groups.label: Planning terms
items: Early Release: a school day when students leave earlier than the normal dismissal time; exact times vary by school level.
Preplanning and Post Planning: staff work periods before students start and after students finish the school year.
Hurricane Make-up Days: dates or references families should review after storm-related closures.

districtFaqs.q: Does the Brevard calendar apply to Melbourne, Palm Bay, Titusville, Viera, and Cocoa Beach?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The districtwide Brevard Public Schools calendar applies to schools in Melbourne, Palm Bay, Titusville, Viera, Cocoa Beach, and other Brevard County communities unless a specific campus or program publishes separate event, testing, athletics, or graduation details.

districtFaqs.q: Are Brevard early release days usually on Fridays?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The printable Brevard district calendars list many Friday early release days, with additional exam early release windows near the end of each semester. Families should use the year-specific calendar because the exact Friday dates change.

districtFaqs.q: Do kindergarten and pre-kindergarten start on the same day as other Brevard students?
districtFaqs.a: No. Brevard's official calendars list separate first days for kindergarten and pre-kindergarten after the first day for most students.

districtFaqs.q: How does Brevard handle hurricane make-up days?
districtFaqs.a: The official district calendar points families to a separate document identifying Hurricane Make-up Days. After storm closures, families should verify that make-up day document and district announcements before finalizing late-May or early-June plans.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Brevard calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Brevard Public Schools printable district calendar page and campus announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates summarizes official district documents and is not affiliated with Brevard Public Schools.
